import datetime

import json

OUT = ROOT / "calibration/src-001/replay/preparation" / PREP
BASE = "8236b9f35c38cdd604b2389b42589f27755cdade"
RELEASE = "c949ea5f39daef42d22ca2e4111164d63dffcbf1"

AUTH_PATH = "calibration/src-001/core-design-basis/AUTHORIZED-blind-src-001-replay-preparation-20260914.md"
PROTOCOL = "calibration/src-001/replay/protocol/sha256-52e1f1bae4cbf91dbaf9699b69bad5885e37ce503db7fcb16ea2fe32a0e10ed8"

def sha(b):
    return "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()

def canonical(d):
    return (json.dumps(d, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode()

def save(name, d):
    with (OUT / name).open("xb") as f:
        f.write(canonical(d))
    (OUT / name).chmod(0o644)

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", *args], cwd=ROOT)

def ref(path, rev=BASE):
    b = git("show", rev + ":" + path)
    return {"path": path, "commit": rev, "git_blob": git("rev-parse", rev + ":" + path).decode().strip(),
            "byte_length": str(len(b)), "sha256": sha(b)}

commands = []
for args in [["show", "-s", "--format=%H %T %P", BASE],
             ["show", "-s", "--format=%H %T %P", RELEASE],
             ["show", "-s", "--format=%H %T %P", AUTH],
             ["rev-parse", "--is-shallow-repository"],
             ["replace", "-l"], ["rev-list", "--count", BASE],
             ["fsck", "--connectivity-only", "--no-dangling", BASE],
             ["merge-base", "--is-ancestor", RELEASE, BASE],
             ["merge-base", "--is-ancestor", "82b0a184b4bf693381b6e22851a08aa66b6a04ba", BASE],
             ["for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname) %(objectname)", "refs/heads", "refs/stash"],
             ["stash", "list", "--format=%gd %H %gs"], ["worktree", "list", "--porcelain"]]:
    p = subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0
    commands.append({"argv": ["git", *args], "exit": "0",
                     "stdout": p.stdout.decode(), "stderr": p.stderr.decode()})
assert git("rev-parse", "HEAD").decode().strip() == AUTH
save("repository-verification.json", {
    "format": "src001-preparation-repository-verification/v1", "preparation_id": PREP,
    "canonical_base": {"repository": "0xHoneyJar/loa-aleph", "commit": BASE,
                       "tree": "72075f93bc9fcb3c76f4480bc612693211efd240"},
    "release_source": {"commit": RELEASE, "tree": "8ced176e50da0d05070b164cfe725752df947d3f"},
    "commands": commands,
    "initial_observations": {
        "capture_class": "Earlier tool outcomes transcribed; current checks above independently reopen identity.",
        "initial_head": "82b0a184b4bf693381b6e22851a08aa66b6a04ba",
        "initial_status_porcelain": "", "initial_branch": "agent/src-001-blind-replay-harness-implementation-20260914",
        "initial_local_main": RELEASE, "initial_origin_main": RELEASE,
        "live_remote_main": BASE,
        "live_remote_command": ["git", "ls-remote", "origin", "refs/heads/main"],
        "fetch_command": ["git", "fetch", "--no-tags", "origin", BASE],
        "branch_created_from": BASE,
        "initial_network_failure": "Sandbox DNS could not resolve github.com; same remote check passed in permitted host context.",
        "local_refs_policy": "Stale local main/origin/main remain unchanged; exact fetched merge used directly."

    "attempt_directory_present": (ROOT / "calibration/src-001/replay/attempts").exists(),
    "retained_empty_probe": {"path": "grimoires/loa/aleph/runs/RUN-RETAINED-SLICE7-PROBE",
                            "entries": ["control/"], "regular_files": "0", "changed": False}
})
authorities = [ref(AUTH_PATH, AUTH)]
for name in ["PROPOSED-blind-src-001-replay-harness-design-20260914.md",
             "ADOPTED-blind-src-001-replay-harness-design-20260914.md",
             "ADOPTED-blind-src-001-replay-Q-R1-execution-policy-clarification-20260914.md",
             "AUTHORIZED-blind-src-001-replay-harness-implementation-20260914.md",
             "AUTHORIZED-blind-src-001-replay-harness-implementation-reconciliation-path-clarification-20260914.md"]:
    authorities.append(ref("calibration/src-001/core-design-basis/" + name))
save("authority-binding.json", {

    "authority_commit": AUTH, "authority_tree": "171e90ee78d2edada8bcf972bb7580081c435d1d",
    "authority_parent": BASE, "authority_records": authorities,

                      "subject_tree": "72075f93bc9fcb3c76f4480bc612693211efd240",
                      "source": "Human-supplied fresh audit findings in preparation instruction",
                      "blockers": "0", "later_nonblocking_observations": "8",
                      "independent_audit_artifact_identity": None},
    "execution_authorized": False, "preparation_identity_is_replay_identity": False,
    "preparation_work_preceded_authority_commit": False
})

opaque = []
prefix = "calibration/src-001/closed-reference/SRC-001-closed-development-calibration-reference-20260811T162619+0200"
for suffix, length, digest, role in [
    (".zip", 5539645, "f4c42e65d611395c9bacdb7ecf3ab7e4d01b1d21fd50c6c150b0cc6a8847a9f0", "closed archive"),
    ("-manifest.json", 215207, "3bc9e618b98faef9f1aa4ebbca02c5c8d9c29e955d853b5b6e497a3d17cf9dcf", "opaque closed manifest")]:
    path = prefix + suffix
    p = ROOT / path
    s = p.lstat()
    assert stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) and s.st_nlink == 1
    b = p.read_bytes()
    assert len(b) == length and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() == digest
    second = p.read_bytes()
    assert b == second
    opaque.append({"path": path, "role": role, "byte_length": str(len(b)),
                   "sha256": sha(b), "git_blob": git("rev-parse", BASE + ":" + path).decode().strip(),
                   "mode": format(stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode), "04o"),
                   "uid": str(s.st_uid), "gid": str(s.st_gid), "link_count": str(s.st_nlink),
                   "repeat_raw_bytes_equal": True, "operation": "whole-file bytes hashed; no archive parser or manifest JSON parser invoked"})
members = []
for name, length, digest, role, destination in [
    ("SRC-001-frozen-numbered.txt", "54207", "5aef61988ff0db6f2ecc2b7980f370583a317e2427c85a6f78adc3ccc8a1d22a", "authoritative frozen line-addressable text", "inputs/source/SRC-001-frozen-numbered.txt"),
    ("SRC-001-extraction-criteria.normalized.md", "4297", "1df51f9872895a3a87a9face2bafe50db34cdfbfd73826e2a31f531c4c538df8", "exact frozen criteria; not corpus evidence", "inputs/criteria/SRC-001-extraction-criteria.normalized.md"),
    ("SRC-001-declared.pdf", "1438944", "c115123a511418ab46f04c4f9f78b6a569712960dbe9ca596d4edd6f0686d521", "same source upstream capture asset; not independent source", "inputs/source/SRC-001-declared.pdf"),
    ("SRC-001-extraction-criteria.original.md", "4298", "f76b5e14ced86a72f955dd130d18b39080cf6a76c200cdfaf7f516446d411369", "provenance only; withheld from semantic participants", None)]:
    members.append({"member": "SRC-001-closed-development-calibration-reference/evidence/transfer/" + name,
                    "declared_byte_length": length, "declared_sha256": "sha256:" + digest,
                    "role": role, "planned_export_destination": destination,
                    "measurement_status": "ADOPTED_PIN_ONLY_NOT_EXPORTED_OR_MEMBER_REOPENED"})
save("input-prerequisites.json", {
    "format": "src001-preparation-input-prerequisites/v1", "preparation_id": PREP,
    "status": "NOT_EXPORTED_STOPPED_AT_ISOLATION_PREREQUISITE",
    "opaque_container_verification": opaque, "adopted_member_pins": members,
    "safe_archive_structure_validation": "NOT_RUN", "archive_member_open_events": [],
    "exported_members": [], "export_destinations_created": [], "descriptor": None,
    "descriptor_contract": ref("docs/architecture/templates/02-corpus-intake.md", RELEASE),
    "normalization_performed": False, "input_custody_lock": None,
    "limitation": "Whole-file verification does not establish selected-member export, descriptor validation, or custody closure."
})

package = json.loads(git("show", RELEASE + ":package.json"))
save("release-prerequisites.json", {
    "format": "src001-preparation-release-prerequisites/v1", "preparation_id": PREP,
    "status": "NOT_BUILT_STOPPED_AT_ISOLATION_PREREQUISITE",
    "required_actual_build_commit": RELEASE, "required_actual_build_tree": "8ced176e50da0d05070b164cfe725752df947d3f",
    "source_contracts": [ref(p, RELEASE) for p in ["package.json", "package-lock.json", "packaging/README.md",
                         "packaging/package-loa-release.ts", "scripts/lib/bundle-format.ts",
                         "packaging/build-runtime-js.ts", "scripts/validate-core-boundary.ts"]],
    "retained_scripts": package["scripts"],
    "build_A": None, "build_B": None, "reproduction_comparison": "NOT_RUN",
    "selected_provenance_commit": None, "selected_provenance_tree": None,
    "reproduced_bundle_lock": None, "reproduced_release_artifacts": [],
    "release_candidate": None, "release_receipt": None, "dependency_installation": "NOT_RUN",
    "toolchain_scope": "environment-discovery.json identifies producer verification tools only; there is no A/B build toolchain evidence.",
    "provenance_rule": "Actual A/B checkout must equal the Slice-8 merge; metadata source.build_commit is the selected dependency-closure identity. Neither selector nor release digest has been measured by a new build.",
    "regression_boundary": "Any packaging fixtures produced later by the unchanged regression suite are synthetic regression evidence only and cannot be retained as the real replay release."

save("reference-custody-preparation.json", {
    "format": "src001-preparation-reference-custody/v1", "preparation_id": PREP,
    "status": "OPAQUE_IDENTITIES_VERIFIED_FUTURE_CUSTODY_DOMAIN_NOT_ESTABLISHED",
    "containers": opaque, "custody_domain": "existing developer repository; withheld from any future production domain",
    "production_copy_created": False, "reference_open_grant_created": False,
    "analytical_artifacts_opened": [], "answer_members_opened": [],
    "future_grant_policy": "Only separate authority after independently verified replay-evaluation freeze, causal freeze receipt, integrity/leak/quiescence checks, and independent comparator isolation may permit reference opening.",
    "role_separation": "Current preparation custodian is not assigned a replay semantic or comparator role.",
    "limits": ["Original file permissions are observations, not enforced post-freeze reference access controls.",
               "No answer inventory, analytical conclusion, overlay, mapping or score was opened or derived.",
               "No comparison basis is expanded here."]
})

    "closed reference package and all members except exact separately approved exports",
    "human answer inventories, adjudication and decision/correction/close event payloads",
    "calibration delta conclusions and derivatives",
    "independent calibration audits and derivatives",
    "corrections, addenda, overlays and derivatives",
    "expected claim, packet, relation and lineage identities",
    "expected duplicate/overlap outcomes and normalization wording",
    "reference-derived mappings, metrics, selection lists and expected score",
    "developer checkout, Git history and development worktrees",
    "prior conversations, compactions, memory, cached prompts and sessions",
    "arbitrary host home data, unapproved mounts, sockets and file descriptors",
    "post-run comparison material",
    "control-plane proposal, authority packets, harness protocol and producer evidence",
    "generic fixtures, tests and reconciliation material as semantic attachments"
]
save("visibility-withhold-preparation.json", {
    "format": "src001-preparation-visibility-withhold/v1", "preparation_id": PREP,
    "status": "POLICY_RETAINED_EXECUTOR_ENFORCEMENT_NOT_ESTABLISHED",
    "default_access": "deny", "approved_stores": [], "allowed_entries": [],
    "production_exists": False, "enforcement_result": "BLOCKED_PREPARATION_ISOLATION",
    "future_logical_roots": ["/replay/inputs/", "/replay/release/", "/replay/loa/", "/replay/recorder/", "/replay/evidence/"],
    "future_allowed_classes": ["verified complete generic release for mechanical processes",
        "exact separately verified source, normalized criteria, upstream PDF and ordinary descriptor export",
        "role/stage-specific pinned Core material supplied through existing contracts",
        "ordinary authorized future run outputs with exact origin and invocation receipts",
        "required nonsecret runtime configuration", "later-authorized execution receipts"],
    "withheld_classes": withheld,
    "origin_rule": "No catch-all path admission. Every actual delivered artifact requires exact byte identity, principal, role and origin closure; unknown channels fail closed.",
    "semantic_blacklist_created": False, "canary_probe_result": "NOT_RUN_NO_EXECUTOR_NAMESPACE",
    "cognitive_blindness_claim": False
})
schema = json.loads((ROOT / PROTOCOL / "schemas/records.schema.json").read_text())["$defs"]
deferred = []
for name, d in schema.items():
    props = d.get("properties", {})
    fmt = props.get("format", {}).get("const")
    if not fmt or name == "protocol-lock":
        continue
    needs_replay = "replay_id" in d.get("required", [])
    pattern = props.get("replay_id", {}).get("pattern")
    if pattern:
        assert re.fullmatch(pattern, PREP) is None
    deferred.append({"schema": name, "format": fmt, "required": d.get("required", []),
                     "replay_id_required": needs_replay, "replay_id_pattern": pattern,
                     "preparation_id_accepted": False if pattern else None,
                     "additional_properties": d.get("additionalProperties"),
                     "status": "DEFERRED_NO_ATTEMPT_OR_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY",
                     "reason": "Closed attempt identity and/or execution, freeze, comparison, or audit facts do not exist; no synthetic identity is used for real preparation."})
save("attempt-records-deferred.json", {
    "format": "src001-preparation-deferred-records/v1", "preparation_id": PREP,
    "schema_ref": ref(PROTOCOL + "/schemas/records.schema.json"),

    "additional_release_lock_execution_dependencies": ["installed_lock_ref", "run_lock_ref"],
    "schema_modified": False, "real_replay_id_created": False,
    "note": "Preparation records are administration receipts, not instances of these adopted closed attempt schemas."
})

    "format": "src001-preparation-recorder-source/v1", "preparation_id": PREP,
    "recorded_at": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "source_sha256": sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()), "source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
    "archive_access_method": "Path.read_bytes for whole-file hashing only; no ZIP member/parser or closed-manifest JSON operation",
    "umask": "0022", "file_mode": "0644"
})
print("Created blocked preparation administration records; no input export, build or attempt.")
